name: Church Disposables FOB | Skywalker OG
description:
Skywalker OG is a classic strain known for its robust kush aroma, featuring a spicy herbal scent with hints of jet fuel. 

This indica strain offers deep relaxation, complemented by flavors that blend earthy undertones with a touch of pine and a subtle sweetness. Users also report strong body effects, including mild tingling and numbness.

The Church Fob features an advanced ceramic heating element and preset temperature control with 410mAh of power. It's rechargeable, requiring no additional components.
